svg.title: The brevis.sh ecosystem: where data comes from, the four pieces, where it lands
svg.desc: The control plane is the Core: it schedules, queues and starts one pod per step, and never touches the data; no line reaches it. The data plane is the SDK, which fetches from HTTP, Postgres, MySQL and files; the Gateway, which receives POSTs from webhooks and apps; and SQL, which models where the data already landed. Destinations: tables in BigQuery, Postgres, MySQL and Redshift; topics in Pub/Sub, with Kafka, RabbitMQ and SQS soon; files in S3, GCS or any S3-compatible bucket.
